subject: Predicting in all locations, including those not appearing in specific years

messages.author: 5d15f8dd0ee5bced
messages.subject: Predicting in all locations, including those not appearing in specific years
parts:
Dear INLA group

I have been recently introduced to INLA and I am absolutely amazed by its capabilities. Its a steep learning curve but so rewarding. 

I have recently successfully fitted an spatiotemporal atuoregressive model to fisheries data on a year by year time steps. My objective is to use this model to predict values of my response variable (using certain values of my covariates) for ALL locations in each year (weather this locations were present or not in that specific year. 

I built a stack where my response is NA, my covariate values are set to their averages, except the year categorical values, and using the same spatiotemporal field defined as :

#Define the spatial random field
w1.index<-inla.spde.make.index(name="w",
                               n.spde=mesh1$n,
                               n.group = NGroups) #14 Years

and the weighting factors of the mesh

#Defining weighting factors of the mesh
A1<-inla.spde.make.A(mesh1,
                     group = as.integer(as.character(DF$fYear))-1990,
                     loc = Loc)



However, I think that by doing this, the model is predicting for each year at the locations that were present in that year, and I want to predict for every location in all years (no matter if they were present or not) .

Is this possible? What I am missing? Any help or bibliography that could point me in the right direction would be greatly appreciated. 

Kind regards

Guillermo
